$comment: The reviewed wording of the in-game changelog (scripts/build-changelog.mjs). Keys are commit subjects. hide: updates players don't see, by why. rewrite: the subject as players read it, 'Area: what changed'. Anything else is shown as written if it passes the generator's checks. None of this ships: only src/data/changelog.json does.
